profile.description: Comma-separated list of sos profiles to enable (e.g., 'networking, storage'). Defaults to 'default' if not specified.

batch.description: Enable batch mode to suppress interactive prompts.

threads.description: Number of concurrent threads for data collection.

compression_type.description: Compression method for the final archive (zip, gz, bz2, xz).

label.description: Arbitrary identifier to append to the archive filename.

case_id.description: Support case identifier to include in the archive metadata.

log_size.description: Maximum size in MiB for collected logs. 0 means unlimited.

journal_size.description: Maximum size in MiB for collected journals. 0 means unlimited.

plugin_timeout.description: Global timeout in seconds for each plugin to complete. 0 means no limit.

cmd_timeout.description: Global timeout in seconds for individual command execution. 0 means no limit.

tmp_dir.description: Directory used for temporary files and staging the archive.

upload.description: Attempt to upload the archive to a remote location after collection.

upload_directory.description: Remote directory path to upload to.

upload_method.description: HTTP method for upload (put, post, auto).

upload_protocol.description: Protocol override for upload (https, ftp, sftp, auto).

upload_no_ssl_verify.description: Disable SSL certificate verification for HTTPS uploads.

encrypt.description: Encrypt the resulting archive using GPG or symmetric encryption.

encrypt_key.description: GPG key ID or recipient for asymmetric encryption.

skip_plugins.description: List of plugin names to disable during collection.

enable_plugins.description: List of additional plugin names to enable.

only_plugins.description: List of plugin names to enable exclusively (disabling others).

skip_commands.description: List of shell-wildcard patterns for commands to skip execution.

skip_files.description: List of file path patterns to skip collection.

allow_system_changes.description: Allow plugins to run commands that might modify system state.

low_priority.description: Run sos with low priority (niceness 19) to reduce impact on the system.

sysroot.description: Alternate root filesystem path for container or image analysis.

chroot.description: Chroot mode setting: auto, always, or never.

namespaces.description: Limit namespaces for collection. 0 means all namespaces.

container_runtime.description: Force container runtime for data collection (auto, podman, docker, none).

plugin_options.description: List of plugin-specific option objects to configure individual plugins. Each object must have keys: plugin (string), option (string), value (string). e.g., [{'plugin': 'logs', 'option': 'timeout', 'value': '600'}]. The items map is: plugin: {type: string, default: '', description: Plugin name}, option: {type: string, default: '', description: Option name within the plugin}, value: {type: string, default: '', description: Value for the option}.
